paper_reference.source: arXiv 2508.14112 v2, Sec. 2.6.3, Table 4; metrics Eq. 21-23

implied_by_table4.note: Eq. 21-23 fix the confusion matrix up to scale; the Table 4 triple has a unique solution.

rules.finetune_eval_logit_gt_0.5: finetune.evaluate_model: DistributedClassificationMetrics(threshold=0.5) fed raw logits, i.e. logit > 0.5 (probability > 0.6225)

reweighting_formula: TP = pi*TPR, FN = pi*(1-TPR), FP = (1-pi)*FPR, TN = (1-pi)*(1-FPR); HSS and F1 = Eq. 22 and 23 of these counts. Closed forms: F1 = 2*pi*TPR / (pi*(1+TPR) + (1-pi)*FPR); HSS = 2*pi*(1-pi)*(TPR-FPR) / (pi*(pi*(1-TPR) + (1-pi)*(1-FPR)) + (1-pi)*(pi*TPR + (1-pi)*FPR)). TSS = TPR - FPR needs no re-weighting.
